# A template variable as a script source loads attacker-chosen code.
# ruleid: var-in-script-src
<script src="{{ cdnUrl }}">
</script>
# ruleid: var-in-script-src
<script src='{{ themeUrl }}'>
</script>
# ok: var-in-script-src
<script src = "https://cdn.example.com/app.js" >
</script>
# ok: var-in-script-src
<script nonce = "abc123" >
var x = 1;
</script>
